title: Amazing tour
text: Henrieta was amazing from start to finish! She gave us so much information on the history of Barcelona and I’m glad to say I’m now much more knowledgeable on all things Barcelona! She gave us a great list of recommendations also, which is very useful especially as a solo traveller! Thank you Henrieta for being so inclusive and welcoming!
author: regm123

title: A complete wheelchair friendly tour of old Barcelona
text: Evan was fantastic! The tour covered both the history and architecture of Barcelona and Evan was very knowledgeable in both areas.  I’m in a wheelchair and Evan was enduring the route we took was very wheelchair friendly.  I’d highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting to get acquainted with Barcelona .
author: sbwc

title: Great historical tour
text: Henrieta was an amazing tour guide & explained things very well! And her recommendations were great too

title: Great
text: We had the most amazing time. Henrieta was the most amazing, informative and engaged guide we could have asked for. Thank you so much for having us - learnt a lot!!

title: Lena was great
text:
Lena was a fantastic guide. Showed us the Gothic Quarter and some fabulous Barcelona architecture. Happy to take questions or explain this in more detail.

EUR1 for headphones, EUR2 for transit as expected.
